sn22.85:1.3: He equates the Buddha’s teaching of cessation with annihilation.
sn22.85:8.2: “Realized one” (_tathāgata_) commonly refers to the Buddha himself, but it may also refer to any arahant. In this and similar passages, the nature of the arahant is discussed, and it does not directly bear on the Buddha specifically. So I take it as referring to any arahant.
sn22.85:10.1: This passage is unclear, see discussion at https://discourse.suttacentral.net/t/a-problematic-reading-in-the-yamaka-sutta/2944
